decision: Preserve the common fresh-session contract. The native compatibility layer now tracks logical session identity and physical entry, restores the base magazine before end callbacks, and prevents old-shot consumption/scheduling from overwriting a new session.
cpu_cause: CharState.tick uses only _in_weapon_change. If BuffManager removes and reinstalls a mode between actor ticks, it skips the new-session initialization.
scheduling_rationale: The freshly entered AR fires at 0.5 and schedules the next shot one 0.25-second interval later; the pinned CPU carries over its previous session schedule.
raw_cpu_differences_scope: Historical unadapted pinned source only. These fields now match in the adapted native observer.
